bluf: Posture Normal. No weather product, life-safety threat, health advisory or outage touches a WashU asset; dry and mild through Friday. The one action today is cyber: the BYOD ransomware group has hit three universities in six weeks, two with academic medical centers (Vanderbilt still restoring; UNM Health diverted ambulances). Thanksgiving break (Nov 25-29) is a thin-staffing window. Pre-break flu and measles messaging this week; Sat Nov 21 is the heaviest Ring 2 load day.
